implementation.architecture: Sibling consumer of the separately frozen dynamic market-universe snapshot used by Engine-0; neither module wraps or mutates the other.
implementation.feature_rule: A claim contributes only when its affected_object_ids contains the candidate security_id and its evidence_record_ids intersects the candidate entry evidence. The feature is the maximum relevant ResearchClaim confidence_bps, otherwise unavailable.
implementation.feature_semantics: Claim-support metadata only; not a calibrated probability, expected return, directional forecast, or validated alpha.
implementation.ranking_rule: Admitted candidates sort by available feature first, claim_support_score_bps descending, then candidate_entry_id ascending; inactive rows retain null rank.
implementation.candidate_pool_prefreeze: CandidatePool ranking_rule_id, ranking_rule_version, and ranking_rule_sha256 must exactly equal the fixed shared ranking rule or construction fails closed.
implementation.trusted_input_boundary: Executable rules and policies are copied before caller-controlled objects; reused research inputs are normalized once into immutable validated records before the dynamic boundary and feature construction.
implementation.decision_contract: Exact feature, ranked-candidate, and no-entry signal snapshots plus policy/rule hashes are bound into DecisionContext and a complete treatment DecisionRecord.
